Root.description:
Displays a user's profile picture, initials, or fallback icon.
Renders a `<span>` element.

props.name: class
props.description:

returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State

Whether the image element stays mounted and loads in place instead of being preloaded.

props.name: delay
